svg.aria-label: Demo on a Notion-like page. You highlight a list and ask 'Which of these is the riskiest?'. Your comment gets an eyes reaction, then a thinking face while the agent reads your project notes, it answers in the thread, and the reaction becomes a check mark. You follow up in the same thread: 'Turn the list into a table.' The same agent picks it up, and only the format changes: the list becomes a table, then a check mark.
